prompt: In what year was the former South Korean prime minister who is from the same clan as the oldest member of the band BTS born?
answer: The former South Korean prime minister was **Kim Hwang-sik**, a member of the **Gwangsan Kim clan**, like BTS’s Jin (Kim Seok-jin). He was born in **1948**.
